name: quantiz
expr: indx = quantiz(sig, partition); [i2, qv, dist] = quantiz(sig, partition, codebook);
comment: MATLAB quantiz: scalar quantizer applier. indx(i) = sum(partition < sig(i)); quantv = codebook(indx+1); distor = mean((sig-quantv)^2). Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship quantiz in core (signal/communications package only); reports N/A.
